changed.title: Exact rational feature dimension across a synchronized cut for all zero-pin queries on three matchings
changed.statement:
∀ (n : ℕ) (σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (A : Finset (Fin n)) (z : ℚ),
  0 < z → z ≠ 1 →
  let V := Bool × Fin n
  let X := V → Bool
  let arc := fun (u v : V) =>
    u.1 = false ∧ v.1 = true ∧ (u.2 ∈ A ↔ v.2 ∉ A) ∧
    σ u.2 ≠ τ u.2 ∧ (v.2 = σ u.2 ∨ v.2 = τ u.2)
  let adj := fun (u v : V) => arc u v ∨ arc v u
  let comps := (Finset.univ : Finset V).image (fun u =>
    (Finset.univ : Finset V).filter (fun v =>
      @decide (Relation.ReflTransGen adj u v) (Classical.propDecidable _)))
  let deg := fun u : V => (Finset.univ.filter (fun v : V => adj u v)).card
  let factor := fun D : Finset V =>
    if (∀ u ∈ D, deg u = 2) then 3 * 2^(D.card/2-2) else 2^(D.card/2)
  let energy := fun y : X =>
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,i))).card +
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) ≠ y (true,σ i))).card +
    (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => y (false,i) = y (true,τ i))).card
  let Z := fun (P Q : Finset V) =>
    ∑ y : X, if (∀ u ∈ P, u.2 ∈ A → y u = false) ∧
      (∀ v ∈ Q, v.2 ∉ A → y v = false) then z^(energy y) else 0
  ∀ d : ℕ, (∃ f g : Fin d → Finset V → ℚ,
    ∀ P Q, Z P Q = ∑ j : Fin d, f j P * g j Q) ↔ (∏ D ∈ comps, factor D) ≤ d

Eliminate an endpoint on an even path using its invertible two-spin matrix. Pin one extra endpoint on an odd path. For a cycle use the signed cycle rank. Matrix rank gives the least number of rational products.

changed.title: Fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality on positive triples and arbitrary negatives admits relative counts at all sizes via deletion to bipartiteness
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ (count : List Bool → List Bool) (d : Nat), fast count ∧
∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)).filter (fun e => e.1 < e.2 ∧
    ∀ z ∈ neg, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let proper := fun (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool) =>
    ∀ e ∈ E, e.1 ∉ X → e.2 ∉ X → side e.1 ≠ side e.2
  (∀ R ∈ pos, ∀ e ∈ E, ends e ⊆ R → ∀ f ∈ E, ends f ⊆ R →
    ¬Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∀ (q b a : Nat), 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let possible := ∃ (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool), X.card ≤ q ∧ proper X side
    let prefixBits := header q ++ header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := 2^(d*(q+1)) * (prefixBits.length+2)^d
    let out := fun tape : Fin ell → Bool => count (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape)
    (∀ tape, out tape = [] ↔ ¬possible) ∧
    (possible → ∃ (X : Finset (Fin n)) (side : Fin n → Bool),
      X.card ≤ q ∧ proper X side ∧
      ∃ z : (Fin ell → Bool) → Fin (n/2+1) → Nat,
        (∀ tape, out tape = bank X ++ List.ofFn side ++
          (List.finRange (n/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => frame (z tape s))) ∧
        (∀ tape s, z tape s = 0 ↔ hist s.val = 0) ∧
        2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool // ∀ s : Fin (n/2+1),
          (4*b-4)*hist s.val ≤ z tape s ∧ z tape s ≤ (4*b+4)*hist s.val} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell)

changed.title: A quadratic-time binary transducer emits the four-uniform pairing list directly and preserves every ternary solution
changed.statement:
let bits := fun (w v : Nat) => (List.range w).map (fun j => v.testBit j)
let header := fun n : Nat => List.replicate n true ++ [false]
let width := fun n : Nat => n.log2+1
let Ban := (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat)
let legal := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) => 2 ≤ n ∧ ∀ e ∈ B,
  e.1.1 < e.2.1 ∧ e.2.1 < n ∧ e.1.2 < 3 ∧ e.2.2 < 3
let enc := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) =>
  header n ++ B.flatMap (fun e => bits (width n) e.1.1 ++ bits 2 e.1.2 ++
    bits (width n) e.2.1 ++ bits 2 e.2.2)
let valid := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) (a : Fin n → Fin 3) =>
  let v := List.ofFn (fun j => (a j).val)
  ∀ e ∈ B, v.getD e.1.1 3 ≠ e.1.2 ∨ v.getD e.2.1 3 ≠ e.2.2
let pack := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) =>
  header k ++ rows.flatMap (fun row => row.flatMap (bits (width k)))
let well := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) => ∀ row ∈ rows,
  row.length = 4 ∧ row.Nodup ∧ ∀ v ∈ row, v < k
let wins := fun (k : Nat) (rows : List (List Nat)) (P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) =>
  Function.Involutive P ∧ ∀ row ∈ rows, ∃ u : Fin k, u.val ∈ row ∧
    (P u).val ∈ row ∧ P u ≠ u
let emit := fun (n : Nat) (B : List Ban) =>
  let flag := fun (i c : Nat) => [8*i+2+2*c,8*i+3+2*c]
  let block := fun (i : Nat) =>
    [[8*i,8*i+2,8*i+4,8*i+6]] ++ (List.range 3).flatMap (fun c =>
      (List.range 2).flatMap (fun b => (List.range 4).map (fun j =>
        [8*i+b] ++ flag i c ++ [8*((i+1)%n)+j])))
  (List.range n).flatMap block ++ B.map (fun e => flag e.1.1 e.1.2 ++ flag e.2.1 e.2.2)
∃ (f : List Bool → List Bool) (C : Nat),
  (∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    (∀ j, Finite (M.tm.Γ j)) ∧ ∀ z, M.time z ≤ C*(z+1)^2) ∧
  (∀ x : List Bool, (¬ ∃ n B, legal n B ∧ enc n B = x) → f x = []) ∧
  ∀ n B, legal n B →
    let k := 8*n+1
    let rows := emit n B
    f (enc n B) = pack k rows ∧ well k rows ∧ rows.length = 25*n+B.length ∧
      (pack k rows).length = k+1+4*(25*n+B.length)*width k ∧
      Nonempty ({a : Fin n → Fin 3 // valid n B a} ≃
        {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) // wins k rows P})

Counters and record scans fit quadratic time in the input length, including reversing the output. The local selector and sealed-block correspondence give the bijection after forgetting duplicates.

changed.title: One signed trace counts arbitrary parity reports on equally spaced cyclic sensors
changed.statement:
∀ (k r m q s d : Nat), 4 ≤ r → 2 ≤ q → 0 < s → k = q*s → s ≤ d → d < 2*s →
  let u := d-s
  let rot := fun (h w : Nat) =>
    ((w <<< (h % k)) ||| (w >>> (k - h % k))) % 2^k
  let step := fun (w : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i => acc ||| ((xor (w.testBit i)
      (!(w.testBit ((i+1)%k)) && w.testBit ((i+2)%k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let state := fun (col : Bool) (w name : Nat) (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    let g := if col then 2 else 1
    (List.finRange r).foldl (fun x j =>
      step (x ^^^ rot g x ^^^ rot (k-g) x) ^^^
        rot (if col then 3*(j.val+1)+1 else 2*j.val) w ^^^ (c j).val)
      (rot (if col then 3 else 1) w ^^^ name)
  let reach := fun col : Bool => if col then 7*r-2 else 5*r-3
  let delay := fun col : Bool => if col then 3*r+1 else 2*r-2
  let sign := fun b : Bool => if b then (-1 : ℤ) else 1
  let bits := fun (a x : Nat) => (List.range a).map (fun i => x.testBit i)
  let sched := fun (c : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) =>
    (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun j => bits k (c j).val)
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (3*k+2*r*k+q+m*q+m+(k+1)) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2^44*(k+r+m+5)^16*(2^(s-1+u)+2^(3*u)) ∧
    ∀ (nr nc : Fin (2^k)) (cr cc : Fin r → Fin (2^k)) (off : Fin k) (bank : Fin q → Bool),
      let p := fun i : Fin q => (off.val+i.val*s)%k
      let sensor := fun (i : Fin q) (w : Nat) =>
        (state (bank i) w (if bank i then nc.val else nr.val)
          (if bank i then cc else cr)).testBit ((p i + delay (bank i))%k)
      let valid := ∀ i, reach (bank i) ≤ d
      let K := fun (i : Fin q) (a b : Fin (2^u)) =>
        ∑ z : Fin (2^(s-1)),
          if z.val % 2^u = a.val then
            let h := fun (t : Bool) => sensor i (rot (p i)
              ((z.val <<< 1) ||| (t.toNat <<< s) ||| (b.val <<< (s+1))))
            if h false = h true then (0 : ℤ) else sign (h false)
          else 0
      let D := Matrix.trace ((List.ofFn
        (fun i : Fin q => (K i : Matrix (Fin (2^u)) (Fin (2^u)) ℤ))).prod)
      (valid → ∀ y : Fin q → Bool,
        ((Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ i, sensor i w.val = y i}) : ℤ) =
          (2 : ℤ)^(k-q) + sign ((List.ofFn y).foldl xor false) * D) ∧
      ∀ (A : Fin m → Fin (2^q)) (v : Fin m → Bool) (t : Fin (2^(k+1))),
        let obs := fun (w : Nat) (j : Fin m) => (List.finRange q).foldl
          (fun b i => xor b ((A j).val.testBit i.val && sensor i w)) false
        let hits := Nat.card {w : Fin (2^k) // ∀ j, obs w.val j = v j}
        let masks := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun j => bits q (A j).val)
        C.eval (bits k nr.val ++ bits k nc.val ++ sched cr ++ sched cc ++ bits k off.val ++
          List.ofFn bank ++ masks ++ List.ofFn v ++ bits (k+1) t.val) =
            decide (valid ∧ t.val ≤ hits)
changed.unlocks: Prices arbitrary overlapping parity tests on a cyclic schedule after the first shared pivot, using a single signed trace of dimension determined by the exterior overlap. For fixed spacing the gate count stays polynomial in the number of sensors and reports.
